heading: I am Robin, Senior Cloud & Software Architect from Darmstadt.
subheading: For over ten years, I have developed cloud and fullstack solutions with a focus on clean architecture, stable operations, and sustainable further development.
about:
I am currently working at FlexHome.Energy on a platform for a more sustainable energy supply. It's important to me to develop software that has real company-wide impact and truly benefits users. My focus is ensuring frontend, backend, and cloud work seamlessly together — well implemented, user-friendly, scalable, and reliable.

Great software is built by great teams. That's exactly why I truly appreciate being part of such a team.

experience.description: Design and development of the cloud architecture and services for the FlexHome.Energy platform, including smart energy management solutions with bidirectional battery storage, backend with MQTT APIs and time series databases, an analytics and management console, and a REST API wrapper for customer onboarding.

Expansion of the AWS backend with robust APIs and time-series databases for data from microinverters and smart gateways for solar systems. Development of a comprehensive Electron application for R&D, manufacturing, and cloud engineering, integrating REST APIs and directly interfacing with hardware components.

experience.position: Software Engineer in Management Information Systems
experience.description: Test-driven and agile full-stack development (TDD) of web applications. Development of Android apps and backends for ordering medication. Migration of critical services to a modern tech stack with API-first design and module federation.

experience.position: Working Student Developer in Management Information Systems
experience.description: Extension and new development of Android apps and container-based backends for ordering medication as well as the development of a test-driven full-stack application for nursing home ordering.
Development of a web-based analytics platform as well as analysis and automated data processing with Excel and VBA.

education.position: Master of Science in Computer Science
education.description: Focus on internet- and web-based systems and AI/ML with specializations in computer vision, NLP / deep learning, statistical and continual learning, as well as additional modules in ambient intelligence, quantum computing, and AI security.

education.position: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
education.description: Focus on software and systems engineering, complemented by visual computing, HCI, embedded systems, and AI. Bachelor thesis: "Analysis of the potential of user-driven adaptation and analysis tools for value chains."
